entities.name: Jonas Vailokaitis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jonas Vailokaitis was a Lithuanian banker and industrialist. He and his brother Juozas Vailokaitis (1880–1953) were widely regarded as the richest men in interwar Lithuania. He was one of the twenty signatories of the Act of Independence of Lithuania.
